input.rationale: Section 9 is headed "Warranties" but contains only mutual corporate existence, authority, enforceability and no-conflict representations, plus a Globix Agreement acknowledgement. There is no express performance warranty for the Site, HDI's software or the Services, and no warranty remedy anywhere in the Agreement (Article 1 sets out HDI's build/host obligations, and the only remedy for late launch is the termination right in Section 1.6). There is also no "AS IS" disclaimer, so nothing would swallow an added warranty. Because no usable performance warranty exists, this is a missing clause; we insert the shortest fallback-level warranty as new Section 9(c): 90-day conformance to documentation for the Site and HDI software, 30 days for the Services, with repair/replacement, re-performance or refund as our remedy.

ops.text: (c) HDI warrants that (1) for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery, the Site and any software provided by HDI will conform in all material respects to its documentation, and (2) for a period of thirty (30) days following performance, the Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner. The Company's remedy for breach of this warranty is repair or replacement of the non-conforming Site or software, re-performance of the non-conforming Services, or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming Site, software or Services.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 contains only corporate authority representations, so we added a performance warranty: 90 days conformance to documentation for the Site and HDI software, 30 days for the Services, with repair, replacement, re-performance or refund as our remedy. This is our fallback position.
proposal.summary: Insert HDI performance warranty with 90-day software/Site conformance, 30-day services warranty, and repair/replace/refund remedy

mappings.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
